{{recipe}} | [[Cookbook:Soup|Soup]]

'''Easy wedding soup''' is a simple variation on Italian wedding soup that requires only four ingredients and water.

==Ingredients==

* 6 [[Cookbook:Cup|cups]] [[Cookbook:Broth|chicken broth]] (from [[Cookbook:Bouillon Cube|bouillon cubes]] is fine)
* 2 cups [[cookbook:water|water]]
* 1 packet (10 [[Cookbook:Ounce|oz]]) frozen [[cookbook:spinach|spinach]]
* 12 oz spicy [[Cookbook:Chicken|chicken]] [[Cookbook:Sausage|sausage]] (pre-cooked)
* 3 [[Cookbook:Tablespoon|tbsp]] acini di pepe (''pastina'', little bead-like [[Cookbook:Pasta|pasta]])

==Procedure==
# Bring broth and water to [[Cookbook:Boiling|boil]] in 4-quart [[cookbook:saucepan|saucepan]].
# Add frozen spinach.
# Cut sausage into small pieces.
# Add sausage and acini di pepe to soup.
# Bring back to boil, and allow to boil for 10 minutes.

==Notes, tips, and variations==
* Calorie content may vary depending on the specific ingredients you use; 80 kcal is reasonable.
* The spicy sausage will impart more subtle flavor to the soup, making further spicing unnecessary. Using different types of sausage will vastly change the character of the soup.
* This recipe may require salt if you use homemade chicken stock. Bouillon cubes tend to be heavily salted already.
